PHYSICAL CONSTANTS AND CONVERSION FACTORS (p.7)
Table 2.3  ADJUSTED VALUES OF THE CONSTANTS
Columns: Constant | Symbol | Value | Estimated error | Unit (SI) | Unit (CGS)
Sample rows:
velocity of light | c | 2.997925 | \pm 0.000003 | 10^8 m/sec | 10^{10} cm/sec
elementary charge | e | 1.60210 | \pm 0.00007 | 10^{-19} coulomb | 10^{-20} emu
Avogadro constant | N_A | 6.02252 | \pm 0.00028 | 10^{26} kmole^{-1} | 10^{23} mole^{-1}
Planck constant | h | 6.6256 | \pm 0.0005 | 10^{-34} joule sec | 10^{-27} erg sec
electron rest mass | m_e | 9.1091 | \pm 0.0006 | 10^{-31} kg | 10^{-28} g
Boltzmann constant | k | 1.38054 | \pm 0.00018 | 10^{-23} joule/deg | 10^{-16} erg/deg
fine-structure constant | \alpha | 7.29720 | \pm 0.00003 | 10^{-3} (dimensionless) | 10^{-3} (dimensionless)
gravitational constant | G | 6.670 | \pm 0.005 | 10^{-11} m^3/kg sec^2 | 10^{-8} cm^3/g sec^2
(Full table lists ~35 physical constants with SI and CGS units; only a sampled subset of the physically most significant rows is given here, per the dense-numeric-table convention.)
